message: No detected input validation: The getArgs() method in controller.py directly casts raw UI text to float/int with no range checks, schema validation, or error handling (the TODO comment even acknowledges this gap).
No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in this code; data is read from local directories supplied by the user with no checksum or integrity verification present.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples in any of the pipeline files shown.

No detected model integrity verification: Model paths are constructed and used (e.g., sgan_args.model_path and checkpoint loading) with no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision controls anywhere in the visible code.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation from training, hashed/signed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The getArgs() method directly reads raw text from GUI fields (e.g., float(self.view.detConfidence.text()), int(self.view.pretrainEpochs.text())) with no type-checking, range validation, or schema enforcement before passing values to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No code in the visible inference path checks model outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or any sanity thresholds before returning or displaying results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses trajectory prediction and object detection models (SGAN, TRAPHIC, YOLO/Mask RCNN), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
